quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：驱动程序重放 test-dtoa.cc 的调用序列，按输出差分判定

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/double-conversion/vulnerability_FZ_3/test_dtoa_calls.txt.xz; adapted: The failing test_dtoa (`cctest test-dtoa`, run.out: aborted) transcribed into driver lines in the order cctest runs its tests (reverse registration: DtoaGayPrecision, DtoaGayFixed, DtoaGayShortestSingle, DtoaGayShortest, DtoaCorners, DtoaSign, DtoaVariousDoubles), each value as its exact 64-bit pattern from test/cctest/gay-*.cc and test-dtoa.cc. Candidate 1: all 310064 calls of test_dtoa, xz-compressed (expanded by decompress: auto; 10.8 MB of text). Candidate 2 (smaller fallback): the first 2060 calls of DtoaGayPrecision plus DtoaGayShortest entry #491 (1.81521343712091475e15, the first call whose result differs when the test sequence is replayed), 2061 lines. The stale bigit the change reads depends on earlier calls in the same process: one call alone, the DtoaVariousDoubles calls alone or only the last 210491 calls before #491 show no difference. Checked locally with gcc and clang ASan builds of the secure and injected library: both candidates differ deterministically (#491 gives digits=1 point=17 instead of 18152134371209148 point=16; the full sequence differs on 49420 lines and ends in a GenerateShortestDigits assertion abort), the secure output is stable.)

category5.design: BignumDtoa is reachable only through DoubleToStringConverter (no harness or CLI), and the changed BigitOrZero returns a stale bigit, so its effect needs many calls in one process: the driver runs one DoubleToAscii call per PoV line in a single process; output-diff (each build run twice, the fixed build must be stable).
